{{- /* creator/folder-page.html — folder card page (arch/26 §2.4). Input: (dict "page" . "node" ) Header: big count · back link · h1 · description · folder index.md body. Sub-folders first (Folder cards), then direct notes as masonry cards + growth filter. No Paginator (engine fixes 10/page) — range the model directly. Streams → stream.html. */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $f := .node -}} {{- $_ := partial "creator/nodes.html" $page -}}{{- $nodes := $page.Scratch.Get "creatorNodes" -}} {{- $subVariant := cond (eq $page.Kind "section") "compact" "full" -}} {{- if $f.stream -}} {{- partial "creator/stream.html" (dict "page" $page "node" $f) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $children := where $nodes "parent" $f.slug -}} {{- $subs := partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" (where $children "g" 0) "by" "menu") | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $cards := partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" (where $children "g" 1) "by" "cards") | transform.Unmarshal -}}
{{- partial "creator/folder-head.html" (dict "page" $page "node" $f "nodes" $nodes) -}} {{- if $subs -}}
{{- range $subs -}}{{- partial "creator/card.html" (dict "node" . "kind" "folder") -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- if $cards -}}
{{- range slice "seedling" "budding" "evergreen" -}} {{- end -}}
{{- range $cards -}}{{- partial "creator/card.html" (dict "node" . "kind" "auto" "showSec" false) -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- partial "subscribe.html" (dict "Page" $page "variant" $subVariant "placement" "list") -}}
{{- end -}}
